title: Flappy Pixel Bird
description: Tap with split-second rhythm to flap a plump pixel bird between endless green warp pipes—simple to start, impossibly addictive to master.
controls: Tap anywhere on screen (or press Space) to flap upward and thread cleanly through every pipe gap.

zh-CN.title: 像素鸟大冒险
zh-CN.description: 现象级魔性手残测试像素鸟 Flappy Bird：轻轻一点扇动翅膀穿过绿色水管缝隙，简单到一秒上手却让人狂飙胜负欲！
zh-CN.controls: 轻点屏幕（或按空格键）控制小鸟扑腾上升，精准穿过每一道水管缺口冲击高分。
